---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  # Keep activities with at least 50 total incidents
  filter(n() >= 50, .by = Activity) |>
  # Leave out incidents where fatality is unknown
  filter(Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean) |>
  # Order activities from smallest to largest total so top activities sit at the top
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = fct_reorder(Activity, n, .fun = sum), fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Incidents",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Outcome"
  )
```
